column1: # A FIXTURE LANGUAGE. Not a language, not shipped, not selectable.
# It exists to exercise the contribution contract end to end: a
# language pack arrives as reviewed DATA plus provenance, and must
# resolve without editing constellation identity, SceneAssembler,
# LabelGeometry, renderer code, or any hard-coded list of supported
# languages. If adding this file is not enough to make a naming
# service answer in it, the contract is not met.
# The names are deliberately unmistakable - no reader could confuse
# "zzø-and-testnavn" for a constellation - and they carry the
# non-ASCII letters a real pack needs, so glyph coverage is exercised
# It lives under test resources and is never copied into the build:
# only src/resources reaches the packaged application, and
# SkyLanguagePackTest proves this file is absent from both.
